name: Art
line: Colouring as self-expression, story and soul care.
about: Art Colouring reimagines the colouring book, blending mindful creativity with storytelling.
Its world had to hold visual sophistication and the simple pleasure of a mindfulness tool, and stay open to a wide audience.
impact: A scalable content pipeline, sold across platforms to wellness-minded, creative buyers. A hybrid of creative product and mindfulness practice, built for long-term series growth.
alt: An open colouring book with a half-shaded baby dragon beside coloured pencils

built.Lore: The name and mark, the book templates, and the themed series and their stories, such as Kawaii Saurs.
built.Law: Image rights, AI-art use and marketplace listing rules reviewed, plus book pricing.
built.Language: Branding, ad copy, social media and SEO for Amazon and Shopify listings.
built.Map: The Shopify store and the Amazon listings.
built.Artifacts: Covers and interiors, the line art for most titles, a distinct illustration style for each series, and print and merchandise.
built.Machinery: A content pipeline for new titles, print-on-demand publishing, and Google Ads and Analytics across every platform.
